boss.anchor_desc: Reality shatters. Click the button below within **10 seconds** to anchor yourself!
boss.anchor_done: ⚓ Anchored! You phase into a fractured realm.
boss.p1_desc: The Veil Guardian shrieks, summoning **Echoes of the Fallen**. While any Echo of the Fallen is alive, the boss takes 50%% less damage. Destroy the adds first!
boss.p2_desc: Reality cracks around you. Every 3 turns, a **Dimensional Tear** opens. At least 60%% of the group must press **Stabilize** this turn or suffer massive damage!
boss.p2_tear_fail: 💥 Rift explodes! Not enough stabilizers ({actual}/{required}). Group takes heavy damage!
boss.p3_desc: The Veil screams. Each turn, a player is marked for **Sacrifice**. That player MUST be Protected or healed to full, or the boss heals massively. After sacrifice, the boss becomes **Vulnerable** , all damage doubled for one turn!
boss.p3_sacrifice_fail: ⚠️ <@{marked}> falls to the Mark of Sacrifice! Boss heals 150 HP.
boss.p3_sacrifice_ok: 🛡️ <@{marked}> saved from sacrifice! Boss becomes Vulnerable!
boss.transition_p3: 🔮 The Veil screams! Final phase begins...

chronicle.frag_0: The Veil screamed as your blade struck true.
chronicle.frag_1: A blinding flash of dimensional energy engulfed your party.
chronicle.frag_2: Time fractured around you, but your resolve held firm.
chronicle.frag_3: The echoes of fallen worlds whispered their gratitude.
chronicle.frag_4: From the depths of the rift, something ancient recognized your strength.
chronicle.frag_5: The guardian's last cry still echoes through eternity.
chronicle.frag_6: In that moment between moments, you glimpsed the true nature of the Veil.
chronicle.heroic_0: You stood unflinching against impossible odds.
chronicle.heroic_1: Your healing hand saved a companion from certain death.
chronicle.heroic_2: Your shield absorbed blows that would have shattered mountains.
chronicle.heroic_3: In the darkest moment, you found reserves of courage unknown.
chronicle.heroic_4: The power coursing through you defied the Veil's corruption.

veil.delve_veil_key: 🔮 **Veil Key found!** Use it to enter the Veil Rift raid.

encounter.breach_boon_awe: Restorative Light , +30% healing for the boss fight
encounter.breach_boon_defiance: Fury of the Breach , +25% damage for the boss fight
encounter.breach_boon_fear: Veil Hardened , +20% damage reduction for the boss fight
encounter.breach_desc: You stand before the heart of the rift. Visions of the entity's forgotten past swirl around you. How do you react?
encounter.breach_field_awe_val: Embrace the majesty of what you see.
encounter.breach_field_defy_val: Stand your ground against the impossible.
encounter.breach_field_fear_val: Acknowledge the terror and push through it.
encounter.flames_desc:
Arcane fire fills the chamber. The group has 5 Action Points per turn. Coordinate who will **Protect** (block flames), who will **Extinguish** (reduce intensity), and who will **Scout** (reveal the exit).

The flames intensify each turn and threaten to engulf a random player.
encounter.flames_title: 🔥 Encounter 2. The Hall of Shifting Flames
encounter.guardian_desc: A sentinel of crystallized time floats before you. Its form shimmers between moments. Every few turns, it unleashes **Chrono-Lock** on whoever dealt the most damage.
encounter.whisper_desc:
Reality is thin here. Fragments of a sentence echo through the darkness. Piece them together and speak the name.

Each player has received a fragment of the phrase. Discuss in the raid thread, then the leader types the answer.
encounter.whisper_fail: "Wrong!" the shadows hiss. Monstrous echoes surge from the darkness!
encounter.whisper_hint: The fragments combine into a single command phrase. No spaces, all lowercase.
encounter.whisper_success: The gallery falls silent. A door of light opens before you.
